Manglo/Playbook/Editorial standards
HOW WE WORK

Useful before impressive. Honest before loud.

Here's how we plan, write and maintain the Manglo Playbook—and how to tell us when we miss something.

Who makes the guides?

Manglo Editorial publishes practical articles to help independent sellers use everyday digital tools. We explain common workflows, show the math behind examples and link to relevant Manglo tools. We do not claim marketplace endorsement or certifications we don't hold.

How we handle examples

Currency examples, margins and product scenarios are labelled illustrative. They are not reported marketplace fees, live price quotes or fabricated customer case studies. When an article includes a calculation, we show the inputs so readers can check it.

Corrections and updates

Requirements, formats and platform policies can change. We review guides when changes come to our attention, update significant content and indicate the modified date. If you spot an error or outdated instruction, contact faikxbillion@gmail.com with the page and correction.

Ads and editorial independence

Manglo does not currently serve Google ads on this site. If advertising is introduced after approval, ads will be distinguishable from editorial content. We will update our privacy disclosures and implement any required consent controls before enabling relevant tracking or ad technology.

What the Playbook isn't

Guides are general educational information—not individualized legal, financial, tax or professional advice. Sellers should verify regulations, rates and platform requirements for their own region and business.

Privacy and reader trust

The current site has no account requirement. We avoid invasive popups and misleading download buttons. Read the privacy policy, terms and contact page for more detail.
